headline: New test: CompactSelectedSeries skips series with out-of-order data
summary: Adds a test that a series with OOO samples is skipped by CompactSelectedSeries and stays in the head, while an in-order series in the same call is compacted and evicted. It only adds test coverage and does not touch production code.
reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior; it adds coverage and removes no assertions.
